Metadata.title: PokéType
Metadata.description: Online typing races to practise in French and English.

Home.title: PokéType
Home.welcome: Welcome! Practise typing fast and accurately by racing against your friends.
Home.joinRoomHint: Choose your trainer name to join your friend's room.

SignUp.heading: Create an account
SignUp.noticeNoEmail: No email address needed: a username and a password are enough.
SignUp.noticeNoRecovery: If you forget your password, nobody can get it back.
SignUp.noticeWriteDown: Write it down somewhere safe or ask an adult to help you keep it.
SignUp.usernameHint: {min} to {max} characters: letters without accents, digits, hyphens (-) and underscores (_).

Credits.title: Sprite credits
Credits.intro: One starter Pokémon from each region and a few well-known families, with their original idle and walking animations.
Credits.official: Pokémon animation sheets: CHUNSOFT, distributed by PMDCollab / SpriteCollab. These imported animations are official game artwork; their upstream credits specify no license. Pokémon and related artwork remain the property of their respective rights holders.
Credits.trainers: Red and Professor Oak: official Pokémon trainer artwork, hosted by Pokémon Showdown.
Credits.environment: Forest environment: original PokéType vector artwork.
Credits.items: Shop evolution stones, evolution items, Poké Ball and PC Box: original pixel icons created for PokéType.
Credits.overworldSource: Overworld trainer sprites — pret/pokeemerald (official game artwork)
Credits.words: Race text word lists: FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, from OpenSubtitles 2018, under the CC BY-SA 4.0 license. PokéType keeps the 1,000 most frequent words of each language, filtered for ages 10–12; these filtered lists are shared under the same license.
Credits.frontArtwork: Pokédex front artwork: PokeAPI sprite archive (Pokémon Black and White), unmodified official artwork.
Credits.stillArtwork: Still image: PMDCollab has no idle and walking animation for this Pokémon, so its front artwork is shown.

ChooseTrainer.title: Choose your trainer
ChooseTrainer.intro: Pick the trainer you want to be. Your choice will appear at camp beside your buddy Pokémon.
ChooseTrainer.hint: Choose your appearance, then meet the three starter Pokémon.

Pokedex.title: Kanto Pokédex
Pokedex.intro: Discover the full roster, evolution families and legendary goals. This catalog shows what can be collected; it does not grant ownership.
Pokedex.legendaryUnlock: Planned unlock: complete its achievement and badge goals.
Pokedex.evolutionUnlock: Planned unlock: evolve its previous form.
Pokedex.starterUnlock: Choose as your first partner, or discover it after a race.
Pokedex.previewHint: Sprite preview only. In races, animation speed follows correct typing.

Achievements.title: Achievements & legendary rewards
Achievements.intro: Grow your collection through practice, accuracy and goals. Each legendary is a challenge reward, with no speed advantage.
Achievements.badgeRequirement: Finish {target, plural, one {# race} other {# races}}
Achievements.eligible: Goals reached: it will arrive after your next race
Achievements.rewardHint: Both goals are required. The legendary joins your team at level {level}, once, after the race that reaches them.
Achievements.waiting: Obtained: free a slot in your PC to welcome it
